find_offsets: find byte offsets to split a text file into N roughly equal-sized chunks aligned to line boundaries
find_offsets_of_lines: find byte offsets to split the first N lines of a file into roughly equal-sized chunks
find_line_numbers: find the line numbers that correspond to given byte offsets in a text file
ChunkLineIterator: iterate over lines of a file chunk between a start and end byte offset
Chunker: use a context manager to read a chunk of a file line by line between byte offsets
